---
title: "Publications"
toc-depth: 2
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# The list itself lives in publications.yml - edit that file, not this one
pubs <- yaml::read_yaml("publications.yml")

# Sections in display order (a section with no entries is skipped)
sections <- c(
  working = "Working papers",
  article = "Peer-reviewed articles",
  chapter = "Book chapters",
  dataset = "Datasets",
  report  = "Policy briefs & reports"
)

# Make the author's own name bold; set to "" to turn this off
my_name <- "Lipcean, S."

# One reference as a markdown bullet, with a button for every link
format_pub <- function(p) {
  authors <- p$authors
  if (nzchar(my_name)) authors <- gsub(my_name, paste0("**", my_name, "**"), authors, fixed = TRUE)
  buttons <- vapply(
    p$links,
    function(l) paste0("[", l$label, "](", l$url, "){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm .pub-btn target=_blank}"),
    character(1)
  )
  paste0(
    "- ", authors, " (", p$year, "). ", p$title, " ", p$venue, " ",
    p$details, " ", paste(buttons, collapse = " ")
  )
}

for (type in names(sections)) {
  in_section <- Filter(function(p) p$type == type, pubs)
  if (length(in_section) == 0) next

  cat("\n\n## ", sections[[type]], "\n\n::: {.publications}\n", sep = "")

  # newest year first; order inside a year follows publications.yml
  years <- sort(unique(vapply(in_section, function(p) p$year, numeric(1))), decreasing = TRUE)
  for (y in years) {
    cat("\n### ", y, "\n\n", sep = "")
    for (p in Filter(function(p) p$year == y, in_section)) cat(format_pub(p), "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat(":::\n")
}
```
